Unknown exact date (mid-to-late August, based on internal references to events)

**Geographic focus:**
Asia (Japan), Europe (France, Spain, Italy, Alpine region, Catalonia)

**Temporal focus:**
T1. Historical observation — YES
T2. Forward-looking immediate — YES
T3. Long-term development — YES (El Niño pattern discussion)

**Synopsis:**
Japan has suffered repeated extreme rainfall events — including 361.5mm in 24 hours in Toyama and a destructive typhoon — driven partly by El Niño dynamics that redirect tropical storms toward Japan. Concurrently, western Europe, particularly the Alpine region, France, Spain, and Italy, has been hit by severe convective storms featuring intense rain, large hail (up to 10cm), and a tornado in southern France. The European events stem from a low-pressure system along western Europe's coast combined with convective instability and strong wind shear.
